scripts.dev: pnpm run build:preload && concurrently -k "node scripts/build-main.mjs --watch" "vite --config renderer/vite.config.ts" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist/main/index.cjs && electron ."
scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:preload && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:python && electron-builder --mac dir zip
scripts.package:arm64: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:python -- --arch arm64 && electron-builder --mac dir zip --arm64
scripts.package:x64: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:python -- --arch x64 && electron-builder --mac dir zip --x64
